Analyze the English word "bank".
Return only strict JSON with this schema:
{"phonetic":"IPA","pos":"part of speech","meaning":"the most common Chinese meaning"}
The "phonetic" field feeds this app's sound chart, which has one playable recording per symbol, so use the notation of that chart and no other: Write IPA only in this app's notation: /e/ (not /ɛ/), /r/ (not /ɹ/), /ɡ/ (not g), /iː/ (not i), /uː/ (not u), /ɑː/ (not ɑ), /ɔː/ (not ɔ), /ɜː/ or /ɜːr/ (not ɜ or ɝ), /ə/ or /ər/ (not ɚ), /tʃ/ and /dʒ/ (not ligatures). Stress marks ˈ ˌ and syllable dots are allowed.
Do not add Markdown or any text outside the JSON object.

Translate the following English paragraph into the target Chinese language.
Return only strict JSON: {"chinese_translation":"..."}
Do not return word_alignment or detailed_analysis.
Keep English personal names unchanged.
If the paragraph contains Markdown tables, lists, headings, images or links, preserve all Markdown markers and line structure exactly. Do not translate or rewrite image syntax or image alt text.
Preserve inline emphasis markers exactly as they appear in the source: **bold** stays **bold**, *italic* stays *italic*, `code` stays `code`. Never translate, drop or move those markers, and never add new ones.

Paragraph:
"""
When the town library extended its opening hours last autumn, staff expected most visitors to arrive after work. Instead, the busiest period was early morning, when students came to study before school. The library has since added six desks near the windows, but it has kept the quiet reading room unchanged. Visitors do not need to book a seat, although groups of more than four people must reserve a meeting room. The new timetable will remain in place until March, when the council will review attendance figures.
"""
